title: She Fell 2 Miles Into the Amazon… and Walked Out #shorts
description: Christmas Eve, 1971. Lightning broke apart LANSA Flight 508 over the Peruvian rainforest. 17-year-old Juliane Koepcke fell about 3,000 meters, still strapped to her seats, and was the only one of 92 people on board to survive. Then she spent 11 days following water out of the jungle. Kesta walks you through it.
